summary: 6-axis IMU with gyro + accel, 2 KB FIFO, I3C/I2C/SPI interfaces, 14-pin LGA package. Project uses I2C mode only.
Gyro supports ±2000 to ±15.625 dps. Sensitivity at ±2000 dps is 16.4 LSB/dps. Typical gyro startup time is 30 ms.
Accel supports ±16/8/4/2 g. Sensitivity at ±8 g is 4096 LSB/g. Typical accel startup time from sleep is 10 ms.
Temperature conversion for sensor registers is raw/132.48 + 25. User-visible modes include sleep, standby, accel LP/LN, gyro LN, and 6-axis LN.
FIFO size is 2 KB. FIFO can hold accel, gyro, temperature, and timestamp data. 20-bit FIFO mode has FSR constraints and should not be the initial bring-up path.
INT1 and INT2 can be configured as push-pull or open-drain, level or pulse, active-high or active-low.

section: Use notes for interface and filters
summary: Datasheet includes explicit interface settings for I2C/I3C/SPI operation and notes that notch/anti-alias filters are for LN mode only.

section: Use notes for interrupts and FIFO timestamp
summary: INT_CONFIG1.INT_ASYNC_RESET should be changed from default 1 to 0 for proper INT pin behavior. FIFO timestamp values require scaling depending on clock mode.
DEVICE_CONFIG.SOFT_RESET_CONFIG triggers software reset. After writing 1, wait at least 1 ms before any other register access.
INT_CONFIG controls polarity, drive, and pulse/latched behavior. FIFO_CONFIG selects bypass, stream, or stop-on-full FIFO mode.
INT_STATUS is read-to-clear. RESET_DONE_INT, DATA_RDY_INT, FIFO threshold/full flags live here. FIFO_COUNTH/FIFO_COUNTL report buffered data count.
SIGNAL_PATH_RESET provides FIFO flush and signal-path reset helpers. INT_STATUS2/3 expose WOM and APEX-related flags.
PWR_MGMT0 controls temp sensor enable plus gyro/accel modes. After OFF-to-ON transition, do not issue register writes for 200 us. Gyro should remain on at least 45 ms.
GYRO_CONFIG0 holds gyro full-scale range and UI ODR. Reset value 0x06 means ±2000 dps and 1 kHz.
ACCEL_CONFIG0 holds accel full-scale range and UI ODR. Reset value 0x06 means ±16 g and 1 kHz. For ±8 g and 1 kHz, write 0x26.
GYRO_ACCEL_CONFIG0 controls shared UI filter bandwidth behavior for gyro and accel. Keep default reset value 0x11 until basic data path is verified.
WHO_AM_I reset value is 0x47. REG_BANK_SEL selects banks 0,1,2,4. WHO_AM_I is not the same as I2C slave address.
